subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should this broad field-report issue stay open as an umbrella, or should maintainers split/link the remaining slices into narrower issues and retire the umbrella?
rationale: The issue spans config recovery, Discord/channel delivery, cron ergonomics, web search, setup auth, resource policy, and update process behavior; current main proves only partial fixes, so the remaining choice is issue hygiene and product scope rather than one code repair.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link the remaining work to focused owner-scoped issues, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 as active canonical trackers, then close this umbrella when the split is complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad production field-report tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue immediately in favor of the active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices may need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the remaining work to focused owner-scoped issues, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 as active canonical trackers, then close this umbrella when the split is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a cross-surface product-routing and issue-hygiene choice rather than a single code-owner repair.
